pages.title: Maokopia
pages.text: $(o)Maokopia$() ($(o)Maokopia ronaldi$()) is the smallest known diprotodont, found in the high mountains of western New Guinea.$(br2)It lived in subalpine grassland and forest during the Late Pleistocene, at altitudes few other large mammals reached.$(br2)Maokopia was roughly the size of a large wombat or a small pig.
